_comment: Baseline of accepted UNCONDITIONAL `.skip(`/`.only(` sites (it.skip(,
test.skip(, describe.skip(, *.only(). Produced by the AR14 skip-suite
triage (2026-07). Every entry here is a documented FIX or
needs-infra-run-nightly item with an inline `// TRIAGE(AR14): ...`
comment at the site — see that comment for the reason.
The env-guarded pattern (`describe.skipIf(...)`, `it.skipIf(...)`, and
`const suite = TEST_DB_URL ? describe : describe.skip;`) is a LEGITIMATE
guard, not a dead skip, and is intentionally invisible to this baseline
and to scripts/check-new-skips.mjs (it only matches the `(skip|only)(`
call form, never `skipIf`/`runIf`, and the ternary form never has a
trailing `(` so it can't match either).
`.only(` entries are NEVER accepted regardless of this file's contents —
the checker treats any `.only(` as an automatic failure. Do not add one
here to work around that.
Adding a NEW entry here is a deliberate, reviewable act: a PR that adds
an unconditional skip must also add its baseline entry (with a reason)
in the same diff, so the reviewer sees both together.
Removing an entry (because the test was fixed or deleted) is welcome
and requires no extra ceremony — the checker never fails on an entry
that's disappeared.
